composition.serve_who: Sheet 12 of 196D5023 is a BAE Systems Controls harness/pinout drawing for two BEL (Battery Eliminator/Inverter) chain segments — BEL1-S (chain S3) and BEL2-S (chain S4) — each terminating into a BEL connector (RTN1), a SYNC twisted-pair connector, and a CAN-A (Shield/HI/LO) connector. Given the established facts that BEL nodes 629-bel1-s and 629-bel2-s are STBD BEL converters (BAE System logical 629, GMMS 110d/e), and the pin labels G3-S3xxx / G3-S4xxx map directly to the BEL1-S / BEL2-S terminal strips shown here, this sheet's two device groups attach to node 629-bel1-s (S3 chain) and node 629-bel2-s (S4 chain) respectively as their internal wiring/loop-membership detail. No breakers/fuses/switches are shown; this is a pure point-to-point CAN/sync/battery-return wiring diagram, so no separate infrastructure (bus) node facts are needed beyond noting the shared BEL CAN-bus daisy-chain topology already captured at 629-bel.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: BEL1-S (STBD BEL converter, chain segment S3)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal strip labeled BEL1-S with net names prefixed G3-S3... matches the established 629-bel1-s STBD BEL converter node; this sheet documents its internal chain wiring (BEL/SYNC/CAN-A connectors) rather than a new system.

functions.label: S3 chain harness wiring (BEL/SYNC/CAN-A)
functions.what_it_does: Carries battery return, frequency-select, sync, address, enable, CAN-bus and chain supply/output signals between the BEL1-S terminal strip and the BEL, SYNC and CAN-A connector blocks that daisy-chain this BEL unit into the sensor/control chain.

flow_scenarios.path: BEL1-S terminal strip pin 7 (G3-S3R1 VBATTERY RTN) via crossed twisted-pair wire to BEL connector pin RTN1, and to SYNC connector (labeled G3-S3R1 SYNC_RTN) — providing the battery-return reference for both the BEL power return and the SYNC circuit return.

BEL1-S pin 3 (G3-S3S2 SYNC) routes via crossed wiring to SYNC connector pin 3; SYNC connector pin 10 is the mating chain-sync line — pins 10/3 form the twisted sync pair between this BEL unit and its neighbour in the S3 chain.

BEL1-S pin 5 (G3-S3AH CANA_HI) and pin 6 (G3-S3AL CANA_LO) route via crossed twisted-pair wiring to CAN-A connector HI/LO pins; CANA_Shield net (N/C on terminal strip) routes to CAN-A Shield pin, with a dashed-oval splice/drain termination shown on the shield and LO lines mid-run.
Pins 1 (G3-S329 ENABLE), 8 (G3-S300a ADR_0), 9 (G3-S300b ADR_1) are marked N/C — enable and address-select lines are not populated on this chain segment.

BEL1-S pin 11 (G3-S321 CHAIN_OUTPUT) and pin 10 (G3-S3S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY) carry the daisy-chain output/supply signals onward to/from the next chain segment (off-sheet continuation, e.g. toward BEL2-S/S4 or further chain link); pin 2 (G3-S3S1 FREQ_SELECT) sets the unit's frequency-select input.

key_components: SYNC connector (pins 10, 3) — chain sync twisted pair
CAN-A connector (Shield/HI/LO) — CAN bus daisy-chain terminator
dashed-oval splice/shield-drain point on CANA_Shield and LO run
functions.dry_data: Point-to-point harness, no protective devices on sheet; net prefix G3-S3xxx; pins 2,7,11,3,1,8,9,5,6,N/C,10,4 per BEL1-S strip; part numbers not called out — capture at inspection if ever needed.

equipment_groups.equipment_name: BEL2-S (STBD BEL converter, chain segment S4)
equipment_groups.placement_reasoning: Terminal strip labeled BEL2-S with net names prefixed G3-S4... mirrors BEL1-S and matches the established 629-bel2-s STBD BEL converter node; documents its internal chain wiring as the S4 segment.

functions.label: S4 chain harness wiring (BEL/SYNC/CAN-A)
functions.what_it_does: Carries battery return, frequency-select, sync, address, enable, CAN-bus and chain supply/output signals between the BEL2-S terminal strip and its BEL, SYNC and CAN-A connector blocks, daisy-chaining this BEL unit as the S4 segment.

flow_scenarios.path: BEL2-S terminal strip pin 7 (G3-S4R1 VBATTERY RTN) via crossed twisted-pair wire to BEL connector pin RTN1, and to SYNC connector (labeled G3-S4R1 SYNC_RTN) — providing battery-return reference for BEL power return and SYNC circuit return.

BEL2-S pin 3 (G3-S4S2 SYNC) routes via crossed wiring to SYNC connector pin 4; SYNC connector pin 9 is the mating chain-sync line — pins 9/4 form the twisted sync pair for this BEL unit's position in the S4 chain.

BEL2-S pin 5 (G3-S4AH CANA_HI) and pin 6 (G3-S4AL CANA_LO) route via crossed twisted-pair wiring to CAN-A connector HI/LO pins; CANA_Shield net (N/C on terminal strip) routes to CAN-A Shield pin, with a dashed-oval splice/drain termination shown on shield and LO lines mid-run.
Pins 1 (G3-S429 ENABLE), 8 (G3-S400a ADR_0), 9 (G3-S400b ADR_1) are marked N/C — enable and address-select lines not populated on this chain segment.

BEL2-S pin 11 (G3-S421 CHAIN_OUTPUT) and pin 10 (G3-S4S3 CHAIN_SUPPLY) carry daisy-chain output/supply signals onward (off-sheet continuation); pin 2 (G3-S4S1 FREQ_SELECT) sets frequency-select input.

key_components: SYNC connector (pins 9, 4) — chain sync twisted pair
CAN-A connector (Shield/HI/LO) — CAN bus daisy-chain terminator
dashed-oval splice/shield-drain point on CANA_Shield and LO run
